Rust 所有权机制的英文原文在 The Rust Book 第 4 章 **Understanding Ownership**：

章节总览：  
https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch04-00-understanding-ownership.html

该章包含以下三个英文小节：

1. **What is Ownership?**  
   https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch04-01-what-is-ownership.html

   核心原文：

   > “Some languages have garbage collection that regularly looks for no-longer-used memory as the program runs; in other languages, the programmer must explicitly allocate and free the memory. Rust uses a third approach: memory is managed through a system of ownership…”

   **Ownership Rules** 原文：

   > “Each value in Rust has an *owner*.”  
   > “There can only be one owner at a time.”  
   > “When the owner goes out of scope, the value will be dropped.”

   关于 `String`、移动和深拷贝的原文也在这一节：

   > “A `String` is made up of three parts… a pointer… a length, and a capacity.”

   该节还解释了 assignment 导致的 **move**，以及使用 `clone()` 进行深拷贝。

2. **References and Borrowing**  
   https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch04-02-references-and-borrowing.html

   关于引用规则的英文原文：

   > “At any given time, you can have *either* one mutable reference *or* any number of immutable references.”  
   > “References must always be valid.”

   这一节涵盖 references、borrowing、mutable references，以及 dangling references。

3. **The Slice Type**  
   https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch04-03-slices.html

   关于切片的英文原文：

   > “Slices let you reference a contiguous sequence of elements in a collection. A slice is a kind of reference, so it does not have ownership.”

   关于字符串切片：

   > “A *string slice* is a reference to a contiguous sequence of the elements of a `String`…”

如果你要找“所有权机制”的完整英文原文，直接从第 4 章总览开始阅读即可：

https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch04-00-understanding-ownership.html
